name: Sekolah HighScope Indonesia Kelapa Gading
address: Jl. Pegangsaan Dua No.22, Jakarta Utara

notes.id: Enrollment fee kelas 1–6. SPP Grade K–5 Rp5.600.000/bulan; Grade 6 Rp5.900.000/bulan. Biaya pendaftaran = formulir aplikasi; observasi kelas Rp500.000; deposit Rp5.000.000.
notes.en: Enrolment fee for grades 1–6. Tuition grades K–5 Rp5,600,000/month; grade 6 Rp5,900,000/month. Registration = application form; class observation Rp500,000; deposit Rp5,000,000.

steps.id: Bagian admission (AAO) menjadwalkan observasi kelas (biaya Rp500.000).
steps.en: The admissions office (AAO) schedules a class observation (Rp500,000).

steps.id: AAO menginformasikan hasil observasi; siswa diterima mendapat surat penerimaan.
steps.en: AAO shares the observation result; accepted students receive an acceptance letter.

steps.id: Bayar deposit Rp5.000.000 atau langsung lunas enrollment fee.
steps.en: Pay a Rp5,000,000 deposit or the full enrolment fee.

steps.id: Beli formulir aplikasi Rp300.000 di AAO, lengkapi dan kembalikan.
steps.en: Buy the application form (Rp300,000) at AAO, complete and return it.

steps.id: Lunasi enrollment fee dan serahkan bukti bayar ke bagian keuangan.
steps.en: Pay the enrolment fee and hand the payment slip to Finance.

notes.id: Usia: kelas 1 minimal 6 tahun sebelum 1 November; kelas 2 minimal 7 tahun; kelas 3 ke atas minimal 8 tahun. Semua biaya tidak dapat dikembalikan bila orang tua membatalkan pendaftaran sendiri.
notes.en: Age: grade 1 at least 6 before 1 November; grade 2 at least 7; grade 3+ at least 8. All fees are non-refundable if parents cancel the enrolment themselves.

source.title: SHI Kelapa Gading — Admissions & Fee Structure 2025/2026 (situs resmi HighScope Indonesia)

steps.id: AAO menjadwalkan observasi kelas, wawancara, psikotes, dan Basic Competency Test (biaya Rp500.000).
steps.en: AAO schedules class observation, interview, psychological test and Basic Competency Test (Rp500,000).

steps.id: AAO menginformasikan hasil; siswa diterima mendapat surat penerimaan.
steps.en: AAO shares the result; accepted students receive an acceptance letter.

steps.id: Bayar deposit Rp5.000.000 atau langsung lunas enrollment fee.
steps.en: Pay a Rp5,000,000 deposit or the full enrolment fee.

steps.id: Beli formulir aplikasi Rp300.000, lengkapi dan kembalikan ke AAO.
steps.en: Buy the application form (Rp300,000), complete and return it to AAO.

steps.id: Serahkan bukti pelunasan enrollment fee ke bagian keuangan.
steps.en: Hand the enrolment fee payment slip to Finance.

test.id: Observasi kelas, wawancara, psikotes, dan Basic Competency Test.
test.en: Class observation, interview, psychological test and Basic Competency Test.

notes.id: Kelas 7: lulus SD/kelas 6. Kelas 8–9: lulus kelas 7/8 di sekolah sebelumnya. Semua biaya tidak dapat dikembalikan bila orang tua membatalkan pendaftaran sendiri.
notes.en: Grade 7: completed primary school. Grades 8–9: passed grade 7/8 at the previous school. All fees are non-refundable if parents cancel the enrolment themselves.
